purpose: Isolate expected final-feature Dropout regularization with frozen features, fixed training windows and the same numerical solver.

arms.no_dropout: Original vector MSE, Dropout probability zero.
arms.dropout_half: Expected inverted feature Dropout MSE with probability 0.5.

fixed: Same three pretrained RoNIN XYZ checkpoints, fixed eval-mode features and frozen BN buffers.
Same 720 moving train windows, 45 recordings and 8 groups; no sampling-weight changes between arms.
Original vector MSE in both fitted arms; no auxiliary magnitude term.
Float64 augmented least squares, relative singular cutoff rcond=1e-6 in both arms; bias is unpenalized.
All four validation recordings from one disjoint group, native full trajectories, no validation tuning or test access.
expected_objective: mean((X W^T + b - Y)^2) + p/(1-p) * sum_j mean(X_j^2) * sum_d W_dj^2 / 3
interpretation: Analytical expectation is over independent inverted masks applied only to the frozen final features.
First FC Dropout, full-network feature adaptation, optimizer noise and original data weighting remain outside this intervention.
Rank truncation is reported; do not claim an untruncated global optimum.
A change conditional on this head model does not prove the cause of the entire formal matrix.
